description: Look up an AI tool AgentViva already watches publicly, by name ("Notion") or address ("notion.so"), and get its state (up, degraded, down, blocked or unknown), since when, and its public status page. No API key needed. It reads what AgentViva already knows; it does not check the address now.

query.description: A tool name or an address.

name: lookup_tool
title: Is this AI tool up?
